title: Home practical guide and safety card: straw and coin refraction
subject: Science
source: Written for science/y6 lesson 4 (Home practical guide and safety card: straw and coin refraction (portal worksheet; plastic cup, wipe spills))
intro: Lesson 4: Refraction: why a straw looks bent. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To see refraction: why a straw looks bent
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Put the straw in an empty cup and look from the side
Fill the cup with water and look again
Put the coin in the bottom of an empty cup and move back until it just disappears
Ask a helper to pour water in slowly; watch the coin appear

questions.q: Light bending into a new material is...
Big question: is the straw really broken?
questions.a: No: light bends as it leaves water, so it looks broken.
